beats.headline: 9:20 PM · 26 NOV 2008
beats.text: 9:20 PM. Ten men step ashore in Mumbai. In ten minutes, five attacks begin.

beats.headline: 38 HOURS AT SEA
beats.text: They had sailed from Karachi for thirty-eight hours — undetected.

beats.headline: FIVE TARGETS, TEN MINUTES
beats.text: CST. Leopold Café. The Taj. The Oberoi. Nariman House.

beats.headline: THE VOICE IN KARACHI
beats.text: And a control room six hundred kilometers away, watching the news and giving orders by phone.

beats.headline: THE TAJ BURNS
beats.text: At 1 AM, a blast tore through the Taj's central dome.

beats.headline: THREE SIEGES
beats.text: For three days, the city held its breath.

beats.headline: OPERATION TORNADO
beats.text: Until, sixty hours later, the Taj was finally declared secure.

beats.headline: 60 HOURS
beats.text: Sixty Hours. The hour-by-hour story of 26/11 — now on The Sisodia Files.
